corrected_code:
@router.post("/api/v1/api-keys/{key_id}/rotate")
async def rotate_api_key(
    key_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    stmt = select(ApiKeyRecord).where(ApiKeyRecord.id == key_id, ApiKeyRecord.owner_id == current_user.id)
    res = await db.execute(stmt)
    key_record = res.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not key_record:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="API key not found or access denied")
    new_secret = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    key_record.secret_hash = hashlib.sha256(new_secret.encode()).hexdigest()
    key_record.rotated_at = datetime.utcnow()
    await db.commit()
    return {"key_id": key_id, "new_api_key": f"ak_live_{new_secret}"}
